_comment: The painted header scenes of the information pages that stay Sheets (scripts/ui/sheet.gd, header): each is the scene inside the page plate's 8-unit frame, top edge to the row its painted fade reaches the navy (the fade ends in the plate's own colour: ground 6,21,35 against the plate's 9,22,32), top corners chamfered 2 so the scene never covers the frame's corner.

crops.name: pages/header_rules
crops.note: The desk: book, sealed letters, quill, candle. THE RULES OF RAIDING. Drawn 1:1.

crops.name: pages/header_recruit_odds
crops.note: The recruiting tent and its crowd. RECRUIT ODDS. Drawn 1:1.

crops.name: pages/header_gear
crops.note: The armoury and its knight. The gear picker. Drawn 1:1.

crops.name: pages/header_reroll
crops.note: The training yard. The reroll panel is 800 wide, so its header is 784 inside the frame: the whole scene drawn down 0.906 rather than cut at the sides, where its knight and targets stand.
